external_dependencies.benchmarks: Run scripts/fetch_benchmarks.py and python -m alpha0.train compile-benchmarks; configs/benchmarks.json pins each public repository/commit/source hash. Downloaded bot code remains local and is not republished.
external_dependencies.engine_and_jdk: Run scripts/setup_engine.py; its archived source pins URLs and SHA-256 hashes for official engine 1.2.6 and JDK 21.0.13+9, applies the archived patch, and rebuilds project bridge classes.
external_dependencies.payload_policy: No downloaded benchmark source, compiled classes, engine JARs or JDK files are bundled.
external_dependencies.python_environment: Recreate pinned packages from scripts/bootstrap.sh and recorded Torch/NumPy versions.
external_dependencies.verification: Compare rebuilt engine/class/JDK identities against resume.training_runtime and benchmark identities against preserved evaluation evidence before resuming an existing game plan.

publication_revision.reason: Exclude downloaded third-party source and all build/vendor artifacts from publication; preserve pinned dependency metadata.

initialization.method: winner-only behavior cloning from own-rule self-play; no benchmark examples
